# RoomSplit

RoomSplit helps people who share living spaces track shared expenses, split bills, view balances, and settle up.

## Links

- [RoomSplit website](https://split-bills.taranveer.in/)
- [Sitemap](https://split-bills.taranveer.in/sitemap.xml)

## Usage

RoomSplit is an interactive application. Sign in to access personal groups, expenses, and account data. Do not assume that private account or group data is publicly accessible.
